article.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
article.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The critical vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-2026-134624 (CVSS score: 9.3) - A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in N-able MailAssure's LDAP

items.relevance_reason: CISA thêm hai lỗ hổng bảo mật nghiêm trọng trong N-able MailAssure và MONAI Label vào danh sách KEV do đang bị khai thác thực tế.

article.title: Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms
article.summary: Microsoft closed an Azure API Management flaw exploited to target secrets at Norwegian energy companies, with other sectors also affected. The post Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Microsoft đã vá lỗ hổng Azure API Management bị kẻ tấn công khai thác để đánh cắp dữ liệu nhạy cảm tại các công ty năng lượng Na Uy.

article.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ScreenConnect Flaw to Hijack MSP Technician PCs Without Warning
article.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a now-patched security flaw in ConnectWise ScreenConnect to target managed service provider (MSP) servers. article.title: GL.iNet cloud compromise hits routers and KVMs, older backdoors also found
article.summary: Attackers compromised GoodCloud, GL.iNet’s cloud remote management service, and used it to install malware on routers and KVM (keyboard, video and mouse) devices connected to it. The Chinese company, best known for its small travel routers, is still investigating, and it’s not yet known how many devices have been affected. article.title: Signal blocks screenshots by Apple, Google operating systems to protect data from AI agents
article.summary: Google’s Gemini Intelligence and Apple's Siri AI "are changing this environment in a way that’s making it increasingly hostile to privacy," Signal said.
